svg.text: DDR reference geometry + actual analyzer findings
Isometric geometry illustration; exploded layers. Return reference is broad plane copper, not a second etched trace.
Green = analyzer info · red = error/policy · amber = unknown. No current-density or electromagnetic simulation.
